what: The must-not search behind the revised row 23: each in-scope reading's FrameNet definition, classified
classified_by: reviewer judgment, 2026-10-25; not a source field and not construction input (F080)

classes.SUBSTANTIVE: says something beyond naming or grading a feeling: a cause, an object, a thought, a possibility, an ability, another person, a bodily effect
classes.SYNONYM_LEVEL: names or grades a feeling by another feeling word; cannot falsify any bank
classes.DIFFERENT_SENSE: the FrameNet unit is a different sense from the USAS tag it would join
classes.NO_DEFINITION_READ: no unit in the four frames read

grief: someone's death (marked as typical): SOMEONE, DEAD
mourning: someone who has died: SOMEONE, DEAD, before
sympathy: someone else's misfortune: SOMEONE, OTHER, HAPPEN

different_sense.rue/VERB: FrameNet's Experiencer_focus unit is the compassion sense; USAS E4.2- is the regret sense
different_sense.misery/NOUN: FrameNet's Emotion_directed unit is a situation; USAS E4.1- is the feeling
